options.text: Define permitted tools and data, code review ownership, test gates, third-party license checks, artifact provenance, logging and handling of sensitive source.

Document actors, use cases, inputs, outputs, constraints, invariants, error behavior and acceptance tests.

runs.t: Which practical project example best illustrates

options.text: For an AI-generated booking endpoint, verify tenant scoping in every query, atomic availability updates and error behavior under concurrent requests; the endpoint 'working' manually is insufficient.
A hotel cancellation specification defines who may cancel, refund windows, inventory release, notification policy and retry behavior before anyone generates controllers or database models.
An AI assistant might generate tests for overlapping booking intervals, leap days, cancellations and two users racing for the last room. The expected outcomes must be confirmed by the business rules.
Before adding a booking endpoint, an agent receives the module map, repository conventions, current data model, auth policy and one existing endpoint as a reference, not the entire monorepo dump.
